enriched_activities.activity: Lying in bed winding down, sketching art ideas in a notebook and scrolling phone, not yet sleepy
enriched_activities.desc: Lies on the bed on the back with knees bent. Pulls the notebook from the nightstand and opens it to a blank page. Picks up the pen from the nightstand. Draws three curved lines on the page. Turns the page and draws a rectangle outline. Sets the pen down on the open notebook. Picks up the phone with the right hand. Unlocks the phone with the thumb. Scrolls the screen down with the thumb. Taps one image and holds it for four seconds. Presses the back button. Scrolls down again. Sets the phone face-down on the chest. Picks the pen up again. Adds two short lines under the rectangle. Closes the notebook. Places the notebook and pen on the nightstand. Picks the phone up and places it on the nightstand. Turns onto the right side. Pulls the blanket up to the shoulders.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping (night-owl schedule, short night before a workday)
enriched_activities.desc: Lies on the right side with eyes closed. Breathes slowly and evenly. Turns onto the back at about 02:00. Pulls the blanket up over the chest. Turns onto the left side at about 03:30. Extends the left arm under the pillow. Remains still. Turns onto the back at about 05:00. Rolls onto the right side at about 06:00. Pulls the blanket over the shoulder. Remains still with eyes closed. At about 07:10 shifts the legs under the blanket. Opens the eyes. Turns the head toward the nightstand.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering, washing up and getting ready, running behind schedule (Bathroom is free: Member 1 has already left and Member 3 is at breakfast)
enriched_activities.desc: Sits up on the edge of the bed. Stands up. Walks to the bathroom door. Pushes the door open. Turns on the bathroom light. Turns on the water heater switch. Steps into the shower. Turns the tap to warm. Wets the hair and body. Picks up the shampoo bottle. Squeezes shampoo into the left palm. Rubs it into the hair. Rinses the hair. Picks up the soap. Rubs soap over the arms and torso. Rinses off. Turns the tap off. Steps out of the shower. Picks the towel off the hook. Wipes the face, arms and legs. Wraps the towel around the waist. Picks up the toothbrush. Squeezes toothpaste onto the bristles. Brushes the teeth for about one minute. Rinses the mouth with water from the cup. Spits into the sink. Hangs the towel back on the hook. Turns off the bathroom light. Walks out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating a quick breakfast that follows the medically restricted diet (Kitchen is free after Member 3's 07:00-07:30 breakfast)
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the kitchen. Turns on the kitchen light. Opens the refrigerator door. Takes out a carton and a sealed container. Sets both on the counter. Closes the refrigerator door. Opens the cupboard and takes out a bowl. Sets the bowl on the counter. Pours the contents of the carton into the bowl. Picks up a spoon from the drawer. Opens the container and takes out two slices. Puts them on a plate. Puts the plate into the microwave. Presses the start button and heats for 60 seconds. Takes the plate out. Sits on the stool at the counter. Eats the bowl contents with the spoon. Eats the two slices from the plate. Drinks water from a glass. Stands up. Rinses the bowl, plate, spoon and glass under the tap. Places them in the dishwasher. Wipes the counter with a cloth. Turns off the kitchen light. Walks out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed, packing work bag and art supplies
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into Bedroom 2. Turns on the bedroom light. Opens the wardrobe door. Takes out a shirt and trousers. Lays them on the bed. Takes off the towel and drops it into the laundry basket. Pulls on the trousers. Buttons the shirt. Puts on socks and shoes. Walks to the desk. Picks up the work bag from the chair. Opens the bag zip. Places the laptop into the bag. Places the charger into the bag. Zips the bag closed. Picks up the sketchbook and the pen case from the desk. Places both into the side pocket of the bag. Zips the pocket. Picks up the phone from the nightstand and puts it into the trouser pocket. Picks up the bag by the strap. Turns off the bedroom light. Walks out of the room.

enriched_activities.activity: Unplugging and starting the personal electric vehicle, loading bags
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the garage. Turns on the garage light. Pulls the charging plug out of the electric vehicle socket. Hangs the cable on the wall hook. Opens the vehicle rear door. Places the work bag on the back seat. Closes the rear door. Opens the driver door. Sits on the driver seat. Presses the start button. Fastens the seat belt. Pushes the button to open the garage door. Turns off the garage light. Waits for the door to rise.

enriched_activities.activity: Drive the EV to work, arriving late due to a rushed start
enriched_activities.desc: Releases the parking brake. Presses the accelerator. Steers the vehicle out of the driveway onto the street. Turns left at the first junction. Stops at the traffic light for 40 seconds. Presses the accelerator when the light turns green. Drives straight for about 6 minutes. Changes lane to the right. Continues on the main road for about 12 minutes. Stops behind a bus and waits. Presses the accelerator again. Turns right at the roundabout. Drives along the commercial street. Stops at the second traffic light. Presses the accelerator. Checks the dashboard clock with the eyes. Presses the accelerator harder. Drives for about 5 minutes. Slows and turns into the workplace car park. Steers into an empty bay. Presses the brake. Presses the start button to stop the motor. Unfastens the seat belt. Opens the driver door. Steps out. Opens the rear door. Picks up the work bag. Closes the rear door. Locks the vehicle with the key fob. Walks toward the building entrance.

enriched_activities.activity: Working in retail management and healthcare administration: store operations, staff rostering, inventory reconciliation and admin paperwork
enriched_activities.desc: Walks through the staff entrance. Presses the time-clock button to clock in. Walks to the office. Sets the work bag on the desk. Takes the laptop out of the bag. Opens the laptop lid. Presses the power button. Types the login password. Opens the roster spreadsheet. Reads the staff names on the screen. Types shift times into the roster cells for three staff members. Clicks save. Stands up. Walks to the store floor. Walks along the aisles with a clipboard. Counts the items on the shelf and writes the number on the clipboard. Moves to the next aisle and repeats the count. Writes two more numbers. Walks back to the office. Sits at the desk. Opens the inventory sheet on the laptop. Types the counted numbers into the sheet. Compares the sheet figures with the stock report. Highlights two mismatched rows. Types a correction into one row. Picks up the phone handset. Dials the supplier number. Says: 'The delivery on Tuesday was two boxes short.' Listens and writes a note on the pad. Says: 'Please confirm by email.' Hangs up the handset. Stands up. Walks to the counter and talks with a staff member about the afternoon shift. Returns to the desk. Opens the healthcare records folder. Checks five entry forms against the checklist. Signs the bottom of two forms with the pen. Files the forms in the cabinet drawer. Closes the drawer.

enriched_activities.activity: Lunch break at work eating a packed meal that fits the medically restricted diet
enriched_activities.desc: Stands up from the desk. Walks to the staff break room. Opens the work bag. Takes out the packed meal container. Opens the lid. Places the container into the microwave. Presses the button for 90 seconds. Takes the container out. Sits on the chair at the table. Opens the cutlery drawer and takes out a fork. Eats the meal with the fork. Drinks water from the bottle. Wipes the mouth with a paper napkin. Closes the container lid. Places the container back into the work bag. Stands up. Rinses the fork at the sink. Places the fork in the drying rack. Walks back to the desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing work duties: team supervision, budget and cost reviews, client scheduling and healthcare records compliance
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at the desk. Opens the budget spreadsheet on the laptop. Types the monthly cost figures into the columns. Reads the totals on the screen. Types a formula into the total cell. Presses enter. Compares the result against last month's figure. Writes the difference on the notepad. Stands up. Walks to the store floor. Calls two staff members over with a hand wave. Says: 'Please finish the shelf restock before 16:00.' Points at the rear aisle. Walks back to the office. Sits down. Opens the client scheduling system. Types three appointment dates into the calendar. Clicks confirm on each entry. Picks up the phone handset. Dials a client number. Says: 'Your appointment is moved to Thursday at 10:00.' Hangs up. Opens the compliance checklist document. Reads each line and ticks four boxes with the mouse. Opens the staff file cabinet. Takes out two record folders. Checks the signatures on the pages. Writes the missing date on one page with the pen. Returns the folders to the cabinet. Closes the drawer. Types the shift handover notes into the document. Saves the file. Picks up the water bottle and drinks. Stretches the arms above the head.

enriched_activities.activity: Drive the EV back home from work
enriched_activities.desc: Closes the laptop lid. Places the laptop and charger into the work bag. Zips the bag. Picks up the bag by the strap. Stands up. Presses the time-clock button to clock out. Walks out of the building to the car park. Unlocks the vehicle with the key fob. Opens the driver door. Places the bag on the passenger seat. Sits on the driver seat. Presses the start button. Fastens the seat belt. Presses the accelerator. Steers out of the car park. Turns left onto the main road. Drives straight for about 10 minutes. Stops at the traffic light. Presses the accelerator when the light changes. Turns right at the roundabout. Drives along the residential street for about 8 minutes. Slows at the driveway. Steers into the driveway. Presses the brake. Presses the start button to stop the motor. Unfastens the seat belt. Opens the driver door. Steps out. Picks up the work bag from the passenger seat. Closes the driver door. Locks the vehicle with the key fob. Walks to the front door.

enriched_activities.activity: Joining the family dinner with Member 1 and Member 3, eating the portion that respects the medically restricted diet and catching up on the day
enriched_activities.desc: Opens the front door. Steps inside. Carries the work bag to Bedroom 2 and sets it on the floor. Walks to the dining room. Pulls out the chair. Sits at the table next to Member 1. Picks up the spoon. Serves the portion from the shared dish onto the plate. Eats the meal with the spoon. Picks up the glass and drinks water. Turns to Member 3 and asks: 'How was the visit to grandparent's house?' Listens. Nods. Says: 'I will help with the medication list tomorrow.' Picks up the spoon again. Finishes the food on the plate. Sets the spoon down on the plate.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table, loading the dishwasher and wiping down the counters as part of the shared household cleanup
enriched_activities.desc: Stands up from the chair. Picks up the plates from the table with both hands. Carries the plates to the kitchen. Sets them on the counter next to the sink. Walks back to the dining room. Picks up the glasses and the serving dish. Carries them to the kitchen. Sets them on the counter. Opens the dishwasher door. Pulls out the lower rack. Picks up the plates and places them in the rack. Places the glasses in the upper rack. Places the cutlery in the basket. Pushes the lower rack in. Closes the dishwasher door. Picks up the sponge from the sink edge. Runs water on the sponge. Wipes the counter with the sponge in circular strokes. Rinses the sponge. Wipes the table surface in the dining room with a cloth. Returns to the kitchen. Opens the cabinet and puts the dish back on the shelf. Closes the cabinet door. Wipes the sink rim with the cloth. Hangs the cloth on the rail. Turns off the kitchen light. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Unpacking the work bag, organising art supplies, changing into comfortable clothes and resting
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into Bedroom 2. Turns on the bedroom light. Turns on the fan. Picks up the work bag from the floor. Opens the zip. Takes out the laptop and places it on the desk. Takes out the charger and coils the cable. Places the charger in the desk drawer. Closes the drawer. Takes out the sketchbook and pen case from the side pocket. Places them on the desk shelf next to the monitor. Opens the pen case and counts the pens. Closes the pen case. Unbuttons the shirt. Takes off the shirt and trousers. Hangs the shirt on the chair back. Places the trousers over the chair. Opens the wardrobe and takes out a t-shirt and loose trousers. Pulls on the t-shirt. Pulls on the loose trousers. Sits on the edge of the bed. Picks up the phone from the trouser pocket and places it on the nightstand. Lies back on the bed. Extends the legs. Remains lying still for about 15 minutes.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV and catching up on messages on the phone, sharing the living room with Member 1 from 20:30
enriched_activities.desc: Stands up from the bed. Walks out of Bedroom 2 to the living room. Turns on the living room light. Sits on the sofa. Picks the remote control up from the coffee table. Presses the power button. Points the remote at the TV. Presses the channel up button twice. Sets the remote on the armrest. Picks up the phone from the pocket. Unlocks the phone. Opens the messages app. Taps a message thread. Types a reply with both thumbs. Presses send. Opens the second thread. Types three words. Presses send. Sets the phone on the sofa cushion. Watches the TV screen. At 20:30 Member 1 enters and sits on the other end of the sofa. Says to Member 1: 'Dinner is cleared and the dishwasher is loaded.' Picks the phone up again. Scrolls through two more messages. Types a reply. Presses send. Presses the remote to change the channel. Adjusts the cushion behind the back. At 21:10 presses the power button on the remote. Stands up.

enriched_activities.activity: Creative art session on the computer and monitor: digital illustration and print design work under the desk lamp, working alongside Member 3 who is studying
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the study. Pulls out the chair. Sits at the desk. Turns on the desk lamp. Presses the computer power button. Waits for the screen to load. Types the login password. Opens the illustration software. Clicks new file and selects the print size. Picks up the sketchbook from the desk. Opens it to the page with the rectangle drawing. Places the sketchbook upright against the monitor. Picks up the pen tablet stylus from the desk. Draws a rectangle outline on the canvas. Draws three curved lines inside it. Picks up the colour palette with the mouse and selects blue. Fills the rectangle with blue. Turns to Member 3 and says: 'How is the homework going?' Returns to the screen. Zooms in with the mouse wheel. Draws two short lines at the base. Presses the save shortcut keys. Selects the text tool. Types a short title. Changes the font size with the mouse. Presses the save shortcut keys again. Saves the file to the project folder. Zooms out with the mouse wheel. Turns the head to check the clock on the screen. Opens a second canvas. Draws an oval shape. Fills the oval with green. Adjusts the layer order in the panel. Saves the file. Picks up the water glass and drinks. At 23:25 clicks save and closes the software. Presses the computer power button to shut down. Turns off the desk lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Night-time washing up, brushing teeth and preparing for bed (Bathroom is free after Member 3's 22:30-23:00 wash-up)
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the bathroom. Turns on the bathroom light. Turns the tap to warm water. Wets the hands and face. Picks up the face wash tube. Squeezes a small amount onto the left palm. Rubs it over the face. Rinses the face with water. Turns off the tap. Picks up the towel and wipes the face. Hangs the towel on the hook. Picks up the toothbrush. Squeezes toothpaste onto the bristles. Brushes the teeth for about two minutes. Rinses the mouth with water from the cup. Spits into the sink. Rinses the toothbrush under the tap. Places the toothbrush in the holder. Turns off the tap. Turns off the bathroom light. Walks out of the bathroom to Bedroom 2.
